notes: Subject insert. The edit also makes Apteryx tenebris a kiwi (stated in it). Every entity is distinct: the record calls the species newly described, none of the five named ones. The 'only' question (q3) is determinate no: adding the closed list of five to the KB is inconsistent with the new, distinct kiwi species. The two worlds differ only on the count (fol), so they carry no axioms. (2026-10-31: q3 was indeterminate with w1 keeping the closed list as an exception world; the record now makes it determinate, FINDINGS A1.)

queries.not_checked: fol (arithmetic): counts the members of a group

queries.ask: instance_of value kiwi ⊑ {great_spotted, little_spotted, southern_brown, okarito, north_island_brown}

fol.notes: Species are an uninterpreted sort, one constant per kiwi species the model knows (the five named in q3); being a kiwi is a belief (uninterpreted predicate). Only the kiwi part of the edit enters the count (the island is irrelevant to it). w1 stores the count as a figure (number_of_members, ATTRIBUTES.md), which the insert does not recompute; w2 stores the counting rule over the stored list (each named member counted once: an entry counts only if it differs from the earlier ones, so the distinctness presupposition enters the count). Counting needs a closed world: the known members are distinct and every member the model knows is one of the named constants (presuppositions; named_only is what the counting rule rests on, though Z3 does not need it to fix the value). The new member's distinctness from the named ones is part of the edit ('newly described/discovered').

five_kiwis.says: The great spotted, little spotted, southern brown, Okarito and North Island brown kiwi are kiwi species. (stored, as a list)

distinct_known.says: The five named kiwis are five different species. (closed world)

named_only.says: Every kiwi species the model knows of is one of the named species. (closed world)
named_only.z3: ForAll(s, Implies(kiwi(s), Or(s == great_spotted, s == little_spotted, s == southern_brown, s == okarito, s == north_island_brown, s == tenebris)))

edit: And(tenebris != great_spotted, tenebris != little_spotted, tenebris != southern_brown, tenebris != okarito, tenebris != north_island_brown)

stores: number_of_members(kiwis) == count(kiwi(great_spotted), And(kiwi(little_spotted), great_spotted != little_spotted), And(kiwi(southern_brown), great_spotted != southern_brown, little_spotted != southern_brown), And(kiwi(okarito), great_spotted != okarito, little_spotted != okarito, southern_brown != okarito), And(kiwi(north_island_brown), great_spotted != north_island_brown, little_spotted != north_island_brown, southern_brown != north_island_brown, okarito != north_island_brown), And(kiwi(tenebris), great_spotted != tenebris, little_spotted != tenebris, southern_brown != tenebris, okarito != tenebris, north_island_brown != tenebris))
